title: spillway r17: blend c across every playable map
description: Roll the approved Look C proof of concept into delivered R16 without movement/scoring/recording/ghost/lab changes. Work only in look/wt on feat/spillway-look-c; merge origin gameplay first, read-only R16 checkout, never main. Every playable map including practice/lab/legacy gets L old/new toggle, cream landing tops/darker sides, orange jump edges, structural ink, static painted map sky and toon lighting while preserving map identities. Prove per-map input/physics and R16 recordings/ghost parity; desktop GPU paired views; per-map before/after, native movie and comparison page. RESULTS-R17.md plus verified Linux/Windows ZIPs and SHA256SUMS in delivery/spillway-r17. Keep15GB free, prune only own scratch, no private concepts shipped. Push rowb-suffix commits then fast-forward origin/feat/foldrunner-me-build. User likes slice but has not played R16; R17 is visual only.
acceptance_criteria: all playable maps styled/toggleable, R16 behavior unchanged and per-map parity/GPU evidence, paired images/movies/results, verified packages, branches unified by fast-forward with no main push
